description: Ministry of Power and Energy - Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Act, No 28 of 1961 Order under section 66 (Revise the Fuel Price to be Effective from 12.00 Midnight on May 31st, 2024
categorisation: This gazette notification contains a legal/regulatory order issued under Section 66 of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Act, No. 28 of 1961. It establishes revised fuel prices through ministerial authority, making it a regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to implement regulatory changes, not about government appointments or portfolio assignments.
